mapper.select: SELECT q.*, p.project_id AS projectId, p.project_name, c.client_name, comp.company_name FROM projects p LEFT JOIN quotes q ON p.project_id = q.project_id JOIN clients c ON p.client_id = c.client_id JOIN companies comp ON p.company_id = comp.company_id WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.order_route = '見積り' AND (q.quote_id IS NULL OR q.quote_status = '見積中' OR q.quote_status = '差戻し') ORDER BY p.project_id ASC

SELECT q.*, q.deadline_date AS deadlineDate, p.project_name AS projectName, c.client_name AS clientName, comp.company_name AS companyName FROM quotes q JOIN projects p ON q.project_id = p.project_id JOIN clients c ON p.client_id = c.client_id JOIN companies comp ON p.company_id = comp.company_id WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND q.quote_status = '未判定' ORDER BY q.deadline_date ASC

SELECT q.*, p.project_id AS projectId, p.project_name, c.client_name, comp.company_name, (SELECT q_sub.quote_status FROM quotes q_sub WHERE q_sub.project_id = p.project_id ORDER BY q_sub.quote_date DESC, q_sub.quote_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest_quote_status FROM projects p LEFT JOIN quotes q ON p.project_id = q.project_id JOIN clients c ON p.client_id = c.client_id JOIN companies comp ON p.company_id = comp.company_id WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.order_route = '見積り' AND (q.quote_id IS NULL OR q.quote_status = '見積中' OR q.quote_status = '差戻し') ORDER BY p.project_id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{num}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM projects p LEFT JOIN quotes q ON p.project_id = q.project_id WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.order_route = '見積り' AND (q.quote_id IS NULL OR q.quote_status = '見積中' OR q.quote_status = '差戻し')
